_comment: Add team-shared MCP servers under mcpServers above; this file is committed to git. Secrets referenced via ${ENV_VAR} resolve from THIS project's own shell/.env, not from ~/.claude/.env. Purely personal/user-only MCP servers should be added instead with `claude mcp add --scope user`, not listed here. Claude Code only reads the mcpServers key, so the _example block below is inert documentation — copy an entry into mcpServers to enable it.
